name: Gemini 3.7 Flash
summary: Build coding agents on a cheaper workhorse model — $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 output, half the old Flash price through December 31. Generally available now in the Gemini API as gemini-3.7-flash.

name: Harness v0.1
summary: Run an open-source terminal coding agent under the MIT license, with models, tools, sandboxes, and UI all swappable plugins. Points at DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Developer preview, so expect breaking changes.

name: LFM2.5-VL-3B
summary: Read screens, ground objects, and call tools with a 3B vision model that runs on a phone or laptop and sends no images to a server. Open weights on Hugging Face in GGUF, ONNX, and MLX, with llama.cpp support day one.

name: Grok Bot
summary: Hand off real work to agents that keep running after you close the laptop — they operate signed-in apps and websites, run scheduled routines, and coordinate with each other. macOS, Windows, Linux, and iOS beta. Needs Cursor Ultra at $200/month.

name: Muse Glimmer
summary: Run a 30B open-weight agentic model offline on one consumer GPU — 24GB VRAM for the K-quant build, or a 32GB Mac. Handles text, images, and video, plus tool calling. Apache 2.0, GGUF on Hugging Face.

name: Grok Imagine Image 2.0
summary: Edit images by pointing: a magic wand changes only the region you select, segmentation picks precise areas, and background removal exports subjects with transparency. Takes up to five reference images at once. Live on grok.com/imagine and the mobile apps.

name: Kitesurf
summary: Run agent browsing on a cloud browser built for the job, not Chromium — about 3x less CPU and 5x less memory on screenshots, scraping, and form fills, though roughly 1.7x slower. Free in beta on Cloudflare Workers.

name: Seedance 2.5
summary: Generate up to 30 seconds of video with native audio in one pass — from text, an image, or up to 30 reference files. Timestamp-level editing redoes single moments. Public developer API opened August 7, verified at 480p and 720p.
